params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aurelion Sol's''' damaging [[champion ability|abilities]] against enemies generate him permanent stacks of {{as|Stardust}}, which gradually augments his abilities.
* ''{{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' burst's {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
* ''{{ais|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}'' range.
* ''{{ais|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}}'' outer and inner radius, and the execution threshold.
* ''{{ais|Falling Star|Aurelion Sol}} / {{ais|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'' impact radius.
params.notes:
* {{ais|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}} relative size and ratio stays the same when affected by ''Cosmic Creator's'' size modifier.
<!-- Blurb -->

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to {{fd|3.25}} seconds to exhale a beam of starfire, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. The beam collides with the first enemy hit to burn them, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and surrounding enemies every {{fd|0.125}} seconds. Secondary targets are dealt 50% damage.

params.notes:
{{always quickcast}}
* Applies {{tip|persistent damage}} on the burst and {{tip|persistent area damage}} on the beam.
* ''Breath of Light's'' total mana cost after channeling it for its maximum duration is {{ap|30*3|35*3|40*3|45*3|50*158+50*0.75}}.
* ''Breath of Light's'' bursts against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions.
* ''Breath of Light's'' burn places a timer on the primary target, which ticks in {{fd|0.2}} second intervals. Thus, at{{ft|5 completed intervals,|1 full second,}}the burst damage is triggered.
** The timer's visuals themselves otherwise serve no other purpose than gameplay clarity.
** The timer is placed on the initial primary target and any new primary targets that are acquired during the channel.
*** It falls off and resets to zero if a target is not hit within 1 second of no longer being afflicted by the burn.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the burst damage.
* The following table refers to interactions while '''Aurelion Sol''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|channel|attack=interrupts|cast=interrupts|move=interrupts|items=interrupts,true,,false|spells=true,interrupts,false,interrupts,interrupts}}

params.blurb2: The beam will deal a burst of {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} for each full second that it damages the same enemy, and generates {{as|Stardust}} if the target is a {{tip|champion}}.

description.plain: Active: Aurelion Sol charges for up to 3.25 seconds to exhale a beam of starfire, during which he can steer the beam in the target direction. The beam collides with the first enemy hit to burn them, revealing them and dealing magic damage to them and surrounding enemies every 0.125 seconds. Secondary targets are dealt 50% damage.

description2.plain: Against the primary target, the beam will deal a burst of bonus magic damage for each full second that it burns them, and additionally generates 2 Stardust if they are a champion. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against monsters.

description3.plain: Breath of Light can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

description4.plain: Recast: Aurelion Sol ends Breath of Light early.

description5.plain: At rank 5, Breath of Light's channel duration is increased to 160 seconds.

description6.plain: If the channel is cancelled within the first 0.25 seconds, Breath of Light is placed on a 1-second lockout but does not go on cooldown.

blurb.plain: Active: Aurelion Sol charges up to a short time, exhaling a beam in the target direction that continuously deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and reduced damage to other enemies. Aurelion Sol can steer the beam in any direction.

blurb2.plain: The beam will deal a burst of bonus magic damage for each full second that it damages the same enemy, and generates Stardust if the target is a champion.

blurb4.plain: At max rank, Breath of Light's channel duration may last indefinitely.

description.plain: Active: Aurelion Sol dashes in the target direction and resets Breath of Light cooldown. During flight, he has unobstructed vision and Breath of Light has no cooldown and maximum channel duration and its non-burst flat damage is increased, but Astral Flight's dash speed is reduced by 50% during its channel.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' conjures a black hole at the target location after a {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}-second delay|From start of cast time}} that lasts for 5 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area and dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies within.
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|2.5 to 7.5}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|2.5*20 to 7.5*20}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*20}}% AP)}}}}
params.description2: Enemies in the black hole are {{tip|kinematics|dragged}} inward until they reach the center, and {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} also have their {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' to a {{as|static 0|ms}}. Enemies within the center are {{tip|execute|executed}} below {{as|5%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.6}}% per 100 Stardust)}} {{as|of their '''maximum''' health}}, excluding epic monsters.
params.description3:
After ''Singularity'' ends, it generates {{as|1 Stardust}} for each full second that enemy champions were inside it, as well as varying amounts for enemy units that were killed while being within the area:
* Champions and epic monsters grant {{as|2 Stardust}}.
* Large minions and monsters grant {{as|2 Stardust}}.
* Small minions and monsters grant {{as|1 Stardust}}.
params.outofrange: Target at maximum range (clamped) if cast within 200 units beyond it or during ''{{ai|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}''. Otherwise, walk in range of the target location to cast.
params.notes:
* {{tip|Clones}} are counted as champions for all of this ability's effects and grant stacks of {{as|Stardust}} if they are killed in the area.
* The damage area hits targets by their {{tip|edge range|edge}}, while the {{tip|kinematics}} area hits targets by their {{tip|centered range|center}}. This makes a slight fringe where targets may be damaged without displacing them.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block a single instance of damage.
* ''Singularity's'' execute against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} conjures a black hole at the target location for a few seconds that continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within. Enemies in the black hole are {{tip|kinematics|dragged}} toward the center. Enemies within the center are {{tip|execute|executed}} {{as|at low health}}.
params.blurb2: After ''Singularity'' ends, it generates {{as|Stardust}} for each full second that enemy champions were inside, as well as for each enemy {{tip|takedown}}.

description.plain: Active: Aurelion Sol conjures a black hole at the target location after a 0.5-second delay that lasts for 5 seconds, granting sight of the area and dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies within.

description2.plain: Enemies in the black hole are dragged inward until they reach the center, and minions and monsters also have their movement speed reduced to a static 0. Enemies within the center are executed below 5% (+ 2.6% per 100 Stardust) of their maximum health, excluding epic monsters.

description3.plain:
After Singularity ends, it generates 1 Stardust for each full second that enemy champions were inside it, as well as varying amounts for enemy units that were killed while being within the area:
* Champions and epic monsters grant 2 Stardust.
* Large minions and monsters grant 2 Stardust.
* Small minions and monsters grant 1 Stardust.

blurb.plain: Active: Aurelion Sol conjures a black hole at the target location for a few seconds that continually deals magic damage to enemies within. Enemies in the black hole are dragged toward the center. Enemies within the center are executed at low health.

blurb2.plain: After Singularity ends, it generates Stardust for each full second that enemy champions were inside, as well as for each enemy takedown.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' calls down a star that strikes the target location after {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second. This generates {{as|5 Stardust}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
params.description2: Once ''Falling Star'' has been learned, gathering {{as|75 Stardust}} causes the next cast of ''Falling Star'' to transform into ''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'', empowering the impact with new effects.
params.outofrange: Target at maximum range (clamped) if cast within 200 units beyond it or during ''{{ai|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}''. Otherwise, walk in range of the target location to cast.
params.notes:
* '''Aurelion Sol''' will transform ''Falling Star'' into ''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'' each time he gathers {{as|75 Stardust}} from the last time he used the empowered cast, or once he has gathered that amount after learning the ability.
* {{as|Stardust}} required for transformation is denoted by a progress bar over ''Falling Star'' in the HUD.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} calls down a star that strikes the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} enemies hit. This generates {{as|Stardust}} for each enemy champion hit.
params.blurb2: After gathering enough {{as|Stardust}}, the next cast of ''Falling Star'' transforms into ''{{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}}'', empowering the impact with new effects.
params.flavorsound: {{sm2|Aurelion_Sol_Original_SFX_R_Announcement_ready_buffactivate_self.ogg}} {{tt|''Transformation alert.''|This sound effect plays when Falling Star has been upgraded to The Skies Descend.}}

description.plain: Active: Aurelion Sol calls down a star that strikes the target location after 1.25 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and stunning them for 1 second. This generates 5 Stardust for each enemy champion hit.

description2.plain: Once Falling Star has been learned, gathering 75 Stardust causes the next cast of Falling Star to transform into The Skies Descend, empowering the impact with new effects.

blurb.plain: Active: Aurelion Sol calls down a star that strikes the target location, dealing magic damage and briefly stunning enemies hit. This generates Stardust for each enemy champion hit.

blurb2.plain: After gathering enough Stardust, the next cast of Falling Star transforms into The Skies Descend, empowering the impact with new effects.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurelion Sol''' calls down a giant star that strikes the target location after 2 seconds, dealing {{ccs|25% increased damage|magic}} in a larger area and {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} enemies hit for 1 second.
params.description2: Additionally, the impact sends a massive shockwave that rapidly expands from the area over 3 seconds, dealing {{ccs|{{as|magic damage}}|magic}} to enemy champions and epic {{tip|monsters}} hit, {{tip|slow|slowing}} all enemies hit by 50% for 1 second, and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description3: ''Enemies hit by the star are immune to the shockwave.''
params.outofrange: Target at maximum range (clamped) if cast within 200 units beyond it or during ''{{ai|Astral Flight|Aurelion Sol}}''. Otherwise, walk in range of the target location to cast.
params.notes:
* The shockwave radius and path are globally visible on the minimap.
* The shockwave's radius is fixed.
** The shockwave is not blocked.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} calls down a giant star that strikes the target location, dealing {{as|{{ccs|increased magic damage|magic}}}} in a larger area and briefly  {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} enemies hit.
params.blurb2: This sends a massive shockwave that rapidly expands outward, briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} all enemies hit, and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemy champions and epic {{tip|monsters}}.

description.plain: Active: Aurelion Sol calls down a giant star that strikes the target location after 2 seconds, dealing 25% increased damage in a larger area and knocking up enemies hit for 1 second.

description2.plain: Additionally, the impact sends a massive shockwave that rapidly expands from the area over 3 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemy champions and epic monsters hit, slowing all enemies hit by 50% for 1 second, and revealing them for 1.5 seconds.

description3.plain: Enemies hit by the star are immune to the shockwave.

blurb.plain: Active: Aurelion Sol calls down a giant star that strikes the target location, dealing increased magic damage in a larger area and briefly knocking up enemies hit.

blurb2.plain: This sends a massive shockwave that rapidly expands outward, briefly slowing all enemies hit, and dealing magic damage to enemy champions and epic monsters.
